property_summary: For an owner-initiated sendMoney call sending v wei to the test contract itself, the call succeeds iff the test contract can receive v wei, and after the call c's balance plus the value received by an accepting target equals c's balance before the call (so the transfer either moves exactly v or reverts without changing c's balance).

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `sendMoney(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
